intro: Designed for today's evolving workplaces, the Velora Chair combines ergonomic adjustability with lasting comfort to support professionals through meetings, focused tasks, and extended workdays.

features.title: Adjustable armrests for personalised arm and shoulder support
features.text: Every individual works differently, which is why Velora’s adjustable armrests let users find a comfortable position that suits their workspace and seating preference. By helping reduce strain on the neck, wrists, and shoulders during long hours at the desk, it creates a more comfortable seating experience for both office workstations and work-from-home setups.

features.title: Adjustable lumbar support for improved posture and lasting comfort
features.text: When you're looking for the features that matter in an ergonomic office chair that keeps up with the demands of the day, good lumbar support makes all the difference. The Velora Chair features adjustable lumbar support that adapts to the natural curve of the lower back, encouraging proper spinal alignment throughout the day. It delivers personalised support that helps minimise fatigue and promotes comfortable working through meetings and focused tasks.

features.title: Upright position locking for stable, focused seating
features.text: From client presentations to lengthy team meetings, the Velora chair lets you lock the backrest in an upright position whenever you need extra stability. It helps you stay comfortably supported during long meetings while encouraging a balanced seating posture that keeps your attention on the task at hand.

features.title: Durable nylon pedestal for reliable everyday performance
features.text: Built to meet the demands of modern workplaces, Velora features a sturdy nylon pedestal that offers dependable stability and strength. Its lightweight yet durable construction is designed to withstand everyday movement, making Velora a reliable choice for offices, conference rooms, and collaborative workspaces.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
